name: todo_scan
description: TODO/FIXME/XXX/HACK/BUG markers in code and docs: file, line, tag, text; counts per tag

path.description: directory or file to scan (default: project root)

tags.description: markers to look for, case-sensitive (default TODO FIXME XXX HACK BUG)

limit.description: items to return, sorted by file and line (default 200)

include_tests.description: also scan test files and test/testdata dirs (default true)
